_comment: Quick-start focus presets surfaced by the CLI (`socialblocker preset list|start`) and the GUI. A preset is only a STARTING POINT: it pre-fills the focus composer (mode, locked, and a default duration) — the duration stays adjustable in the UI, and `preset start <name> [minutes]` can override it too. Edit freely; no code change needed. Fields: name (str), default_minutes (int > 0), mode ('whitelist'|'blacklist'), locked (bool), blurb (str, optional).

presets.name: Deep Work
presets.blurb: Whitelist + locked — one long, uninterruptible block.

presets.name: Wind-down
presets.blurb: Gentle blacklist — distractions off, the rest of the web open.
